title: ews-nf pipeline parameters
description: A workflow for analyzing Ewing sarcoma single-cell RNA-sequencing samples.

workflow.description: String indicating which workflow to run, either reference, annotation, or nmf_metaprograms

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

scpca_nf_dir.description: Path to directory containing output files from running scpca-nf

sample_ids.description: List of sample IDs to process, must match the folder names in scpca_nf_dir

containers.title: Containers
containers.description: Locations for Docker images used by workflow processes

ews_nf_container.description: Container to use for running individual modules

cnmf_container.description: Container to use for running the cnmf module

aucell_max_rank_threshold.description: Proportion of detected genes to use as the threshold for the max AUC rank when running AUCell

marker_gene_cutoff.description: z-score cutoff for classifying cells based on EF-activated (tumor-high) and EF-repressed (tumor-low) gene expression

annotations_output_dir.description: Directory where the cell type annotations for each sample will be saved

ref_celltypes_file.description: Table of consensus cell type annotations to include when building the normal reference

ref_sce_file.description: Reference cells to use when running InferCNV saved as a SingleCellExperiment object.

gtf_file.description: Path to GTF reference file used for mapping in scpca-nf

gene_order_file.description: Path to gene order file for use with InferCNV

skip_infercnv.description: If the inferCNV results already exist, optionally skip re-running inferCNV

validation_groups_file.description: Path to TSV file mapping consensus cell type groups to broad validation groups

marker_genes_file.description: Path to TSV file containing marker genes for all consensus cell type validation groups

color_palette_file.description: Path to TSV file containing hex codes to use for coloring each consensus cell type validation group

gene_set_category_file.description: Path to TSV file containing categories for each gene set used with AUCell

annotations_column.description: Column name in the annotations file containing the cell type annotations to use for cNMF

celltype_value.description: Value in the annotations column corresponding to the cell type to use for cNMF

k_components_lower.description: Lower bound for number of components to run with cNMF

k_components_upper.description: Upper bound for number of components to run with cNMF

k_step_size.description: Step size for determining the range of k components to run with cNMF

skip_cnmf.description: If the cNMF results directory already exists, optionally skip re-running cNMF

cnmf_k_range.description: Set of k values used with cNMF to keep when clustering spectra into metaprograms, comma separated. Use 'all' to use all available k.

subset_tsv.description: Path to TSV file containing sample subsets to use for determining optimal number of metaprograms. Must contain columns 'subset_id' and 'scpca_sample_id'

subset_mode.description: Boolean indicating whether to run in subset mode, which uses specified subsets of samples to determine optimal number of metaprograms instead of using all samples

subset_ids.description: Comma separated string of subset ids to use for determining optimal number of metaprograms; only used if subset_mode is true. Use 'All' to use all subsets defined in subset_tsv.

n_metaprograms.description: Comma separated string indicating the range of number of metaprograms to use for finding the optimal k

filter_spectra.description: Boolean indicating whether to filter orphan spectra prior to generating metaprograms

orphan_cutoff.description: Minimum cross sample maximum required to keep spectra if filter_spectra is true

repeat_creating_metaprograms.description: Boolean indicating whether to re-create metaprograms if results already exist

score_sces.description: Boolean indicating whether to score and annotate sces with the optimal value of k

nreps.description: Number of permutations to use for metrics that use permutation testing

sample_metadata_file.description: Path to TSV file containing sample metadata containing disease timing information
